- **The condition is met.**
  - `Blocked-by: #23388`: #23388 closed `completed` at 2026-10-15T23:03Z, when PR #23418 merged as `d0c09e47c1`.
  - The body's ordering also holds: #23357's PR #23419 merged first, as `05ab9ef895`.
  - The narrow judge is still on `main`: `checkPageComponentViewData` appears in `page.zod.ts` and five other files under `packages/spec/src`, read in this act.
- **Grade: p2 → p1.** This card had no triage touch; its labels were the filer's.
  - It deletes a `superRefine` on `PageSchema`, which changes the spec's accept surface. It also removes a published export from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, which narrows the declared surface.
  - `filing-gate.md` 〈定级判据〉 says 「修复改 spec 接受/声明面…宽窄皆算」 and 「此类任何车道皆 p1 + 在研大版 target:」.
  - The card's own `target:v18` says why it is window-bound: after 18 GA, the removal waits for 19.
- **Lane: `domain:spec`**, confirmed, and `target:v18` stands.

⛔ Not a claim.

Claim: PM loop round 9 (second shift, `batch 3`) · 2026-10-16T00:49Z · ruling `6161173492` item 6, the follow-up for #23357, unlocked by triage `6204768090`. Delete the narrow judge (`checkPageComponentViewData`, `VIEW_DATA_SOURCE_COMPONENT_TYPES`, its `.superRefine` on `PageSchema` and its published export), now that PR #23418 runs the general component-props rule at the save door. Rewrite every sentence that rule makes false, after re-measuring the stored-page fate. One PR, `Fixes #23447`.

File surface (at `origin/main` `29c7157af4` or later; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`: `checkPageComponentViewData`, `VIEW_DATA_SOURCE_COMPONENT_TYPES`, their docblocks and the `.superRefine` on `PageSchema` only. `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: the comment that cites the judge.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` (its one line) and `packages/spec/src/ui/page-component-view-data.test.ts` (deleted or re-pointed at the props rule, as the pins in the card's item 4 need).
- The sentences named in the card's item 2: the `packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts` docblock and fate text, with its test; `18.view-data-api-provider-retired.ts` `acceptanceCriteria`; `18.ui-page-action-row-declarative-update-rules.ts`; and the comment at `packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.ts:111-116`.
- The save-door pins in `packages/metadata-protocol` (`protocol.save-union-issues.test.ts` and kin). The generated `api-surface/ui.json` and `export-origins/ui.json`, through the generators only. One changeset, `.changeset/23447-*.md`.
- ⛔ Not the page-type, template, region, `isDefault` or `PagePrintSchema` regions of `page.zod.ts`: those are PRs #23708 and #23710. ⛔ Not `.changeset/pre/**`, which holds released notes. ⛔ Not `content/docs/releases/`.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate). Cloud by the seat's interim rule (#23607), because `packages/spec` plus the lint and metadata-protocol pins is a build-heavy closure. Review ceiling `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`: `PageSchema`'s parse stops refusing a shape that the props rule then refuses at the CLI and the save door, and a published export leaves `@objectstack/spec/ui`.
Clause-②: yes
Responsibility: n/a — a ruled follow-up, not a defect card
Thread-read: 6204768090
Ruling-ref: 6161173492 (item 6, letter B, the maintainer's 「23388 B 是不是最简单？」)
Serial constraints cleared:
- `batch 3`, the maintainer's newest word in this seat's session. In flight from this seat: #23708's pin bump and #23710, both cloud.
- All 18 open PRs' file lists were read in this act. PR #23708 touches `page.zod.ts` (other regions), `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts`, and the ui `api-surface` / `export-origins` shards. The `chore: version packages` PR #23481 holds `.changeset/pre/23357-*`, which stays untouched. No other open PR touches the files above.
- Landing-operations D: this PR and #23708 both regenerate the ui shards, so they land one at a time. Whichever lands second merges `main` and regenerates through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`, keeping both intents.
